item.title: Multi-million Albuquerque affordable housing project breaks ground
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – A multi-million dollar affordable housing project has officially broken ground in one of Albuquerque's most populated areas. The Cottages at 161 Chama near Central and Chama Street will serve people making 50% of the area's median income and include single-bedroom and two-bedroom units.
